newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's CMVM, SEC sign cooperation pact.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's CMVM, SEC sign cooperation pact.

text.p: Portugal's financial markets watchdog CMVM and the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) have agreed to notify each other immediately of exclusions or suspensions of share quotations, a statement said.

"The president of the CMVM, Jose Nunes Pereira, and the president of the SEC, Arthur Levitt, established an agreement by which each authority committed itself to tell the other immediately of exclusion or suspension of quotations," it said.
The CMVM and SEC are discussing a broader cooperation agreement along the lines already established between the CMVM and other countries' financial markets watchdogs.
